title: HELIOS connector wiring (config/connectors.json)
description: Slack and Linear routing read by .github/workflows/notify-slack.yml (slack.notifyOn), .github/workflows/linear-sync.yml (linear.teamKey / titlePrefix / syncLabels / githubLabelToLinear) and scripts/bootstrap/auth-doctor.ps1 (the *Env names). The file carries environment-variable NAMES and routing choices only - never a webhook URL, token, or key (repo hard rule) - which is why every credential-shaped field is an UPPER_SNAKE env-var name. Objects are closed: those consumers read keys by exact name with jq / property access, so a misspelled key would otherwise be silently ignored.

envName.description: The NAME of an environment variable (or GitHub secret); never its value.

enabled.description: false makes notify-slack.yml skip every run (green, with the reason in the log) without touching the secret; absent means enabled. The workflow reads this field, so it is a real switch, not documentation.

webhookUrlEnv.description: Pinned to the name notify-slack.yml and auth-doctor.ps1 read verbatim (secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL): the workflow does not resolve this field, so any other name would be silently ignored. Change the workflow, the doctor and this constant together.

channels.description: Logical channel key -> Slack channel name (#lowercase).

notifyOn.description: Workflow display name (the `name:` in its YAML) -> policy. notify-slack.yml treats anything but 'always' as failures-and-recovery (successes stay quiet).

enabled.description: false makes linear-sync.yml skip every issue event (green, with the reason in the log) without revoking the key; absent means enabled. The workflow reads this field, so it is a real switch, not documentation.

apiKeyEnv.description: Pinned to the name linear-sync.yml and auth-doctor.ps1 read verbatim (secrets.LINEAR_API_KEY); see webhookUrlEnv.

teamKey.description: Linear team key (the prefix of its issue identifiers).

titlePrefix.description: Must contain the {number} slot: linear-sync.yml derives its loop marker from the text before it.

syncLabels.description: GitHub labels that make an issue eligible for sync.
